calib.enter_length: Enter the real length of the segment.
calib.invalid_number: Invalid number: enter a positive length, e.g. 12.5
calib.title: Set the scale
camera.busy: the camera is already used by another application
camera.denied_linux: permission denied (the user must belong to the “video” group)
camera.denied_system: permission denied (allow camera access in the system settings)
camera.internal_stop: Video capture stopped on an internal error.
camera.label: Camera:
camera.no_more_images: The camera no longer provides images.
camera.unreadable_received: Unreadable images received from the camera: {error}
camera.usb_bandwidth: not enough USB bandwidth (try a lower resolution or another USB port)
decimals.label: Decimals: {value}
decimals.tip: Decimal places of the values shown in the list, on the image and in the exported image (the CSV keeps full precision)
filter.bicubic_tip: 4 × 4 pixels. The fastest reconstruction filter; a slight ripple remains along edges.
filter.bspline_tip: Prefilter over the whole image, then 4 × 4 pixels. Very even edges, almost no halo.
filter.gpu_tip: No resampling: the original pixels are copied as they are, so the staircase of tilted edges stays visible.
filter.lanczos3_tip: 6 × 6 pixels. Very sharp, close to ideal reconstruction; a faint halo may appear on high-contrast edges.
filter.shear_tip: Three one-dimensional passes with a 16-pixel sinc. The most faithful, but the slowest and the most memory-hungry.
hint.angle.first: Click a point on the first side of the angle
hint.angle.second: Click a point on the second side — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.angle.vertex: Click the vertex of the angle — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.arc.first: Click one end of the arc
hint.arc.last: Click the other end of the arc
hint.arc.middle: Click a point along the arc
hint.area.first: Click the first vertex of the area
hint.area.next: Click the next vertex — double-click, Enter or click the first point to close
hint.area.second: Click the next vertex — Backspace: remove the last point
hint.circle.center: Click the center of the circle (or drag from the center to the edge)
hint.circle.edge: Click a point on the edge of the circle
hint.circle3.first: Click a first point on the edge of the circle
hint.circle3.second: Click a second point on the edge
hint.circle3.third: Click a third point on the edge
hint.ellipse.axis: Click the end of the first semi-axis (sets the tilt) — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.ellipse.center: Click the center of the ellipse
hint.ellipse.width: Click to set the second semi-axis — Shift: circle
hint.length.first: Click the first point (or drag from end to end)
hint.length.second: Click the second point — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.line_angle.first: Tilt: click the start of the first segment (or drag from end to end)
hint.line_angle.first_end: Click the end of the first segment — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.line_angle.second: Click the start of the second segment, anywhere (or drag from end to end)
hint.line_angle.second_end: Click the end of the second segment — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.parallel.first: Parallel gap: click the start of the reference segment (or drag from end to end)
hint.parallel.point: Click a point on the other edge: the parallel line goes through it
hint.parallel.second: Click the end of the reference segment — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.path.first: Click the first point of the path
hint.path.next: Click the next point — double-click, Enter or right-click to finish, Backspace: remove a point
hint.path.second: Click the next point — Backspace: remove the last point
hint.point_line.first: Point-line distance: click the first point of the line (or drag along the line)
hint.point_line.point: Click the point to measure; the line is extended as needed
hint.point_line.second: Click the second point of the line — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.rect.first: Click a first corner (or drag diagonally)
hint.rect.second: Click the opposite corner — Shift: square
hint.rect3.first: Click the first corner of a side (or drag along the side)
hint.rect3.second: Click the other end of the side — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.rect3.third: Click to set the width — Shift: square
hint.scale.dialog: Enter the real length in the dialog — or draw another segment
hint.scale.end: Click the end of the known length — Shift: horizontal/vertical
hint.scale.start: Scale: click the start of a known length (or drag from end to end)
hint.select.drag_handle: Release to place the point — Shift: constrain
hint.select.idle: Click a measurement to select it — drag empty space: pan, wheel: zoom
hint.select.selected: Drag a handle to edit, the line to move — Del: delete, Esc: deselect
hint.straighten.end: Click the end of the line: the photo will rotate to make it horizontal or vertical
hint.straighten.start: Straighten: click the start of a line that should be horizontal or vertical (or drag from end to end)
io.is_dir: this is a folder, not a file
panel.copy_tip: Copy the measurement table, to paste into a spreadsheet
panel.empty_help: Pick a tool on the left, then click on the image.
panel.export_csv_tip: Save the measurements to a CSV file (Ctrl+E)
panel.scale_remove_tip: Go back to pixels (undo with Ctrl+Z)
panel.scale_set_tip: Draw a segment of known length on the image, then enter its real length.
panel.scale_unset: Not set: measurements are in pixels.
presets.apply_tip: Apply this scale to the image (undo with Ctrl+Z)
presets.keep: Keep the scale for the next image
presets.keep_tip: Opening another image or capturing from the camera keeps the current scale. A project always restores its own scale.
presets.menu_tip: Save the scale under a name and reapply it to other images
presets.need_scale: Set the scale first to save it as a preset.
presets.replace_tip: A preset with this name exists: its scale will be replaced
presets.save_tip: Save the current scale under this name (Enter)
project.bad_json: this is not a MeterOscope project (invalid JSON, line {line}, column {column})
project.not_project: this is not a MeterOscope project
project.not_utf8: this is not a UTF-8 text file
project.unknown_version: unknown project format version {version} (this version of MeterOscope reads up to version {max}); please update MeterOscope
recent.title: Recent files
stats.empty: They will appear here after the first measurement.
stats.title: Statistics
status.rotation_tip: Display rotation of the photo (straightening); the image and measurements are not modified. Double-click: reset.
table.name: Name
tool_help.angle: Angle from three points: one side, the vertex, the other side.
tool_help.arc: Arc through three points (end, middle, end): radius of curvature, arc length, central angle, chord.
tool_help.area: Area and perimeter of an outline; double-click to close.
tool_help.circle: Circle from its center, then a point on its edge.
tool_help.circle3: Circle through three points on its edge.
tool_help.ellipse: Ellipse by its center and two semi-axes, tilted with its round handle: major and minor axes, area, perimeter.
tool_help.line_angle: Tilt between two segments, even far apart (0°: parallel, 90°: perpendicular).
tool_help.parallel: Gap between a reference segment and the parallel line through a point: thickness or width of a band, without aiming perpendicularly.
tool_help.path: Length of a polyline; double-click to finish.
tool_help.point_line: Perpendicular distance from a point to a line through two points, extended if needed.
tool_help.rect: Width, height and area, from two opposite corners. When selected, tilt it with its round handle.
tool_help.rect3: Tilted rectangle: two points for one side, a third for the width.
tool_help.scale: Draw a segment of known length to set the scale.
tool_help.select: Select, move or edit a measurement.
tool_help.straighten: Draw a segment along a line that should be horizontal or vertical: the photo is displayed straightened, without being modified.
toolbar.open_tip: Open an image or a project (Ctrl+O)
welcome.drop: … or drop an image into the window
welcome.tagline: Measure lengths, angles and areas on an image.
